column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus update v262144 noble (frenzied boss) battles (bin/pokemon/data/poke_nushi_battle_setting.bin + poke_event_encount.bin)
# note: One row per entry of poke_nushi_battle_setting (8 first battles + 8 '_r' rematches).
# note: species..level, nature_raw, moves, iv_raw, gv_raw: from the poke_event_encount entry with the same name (VERIFIED join by name).
# note: gauge_max: event-encounter slot 16 (1000..15000, absent on rematches); LIKELY the frenzy gauge capacity, not proven by code.
# note: balm_item: setting slot 26; every value is a 'shizumedama' (balm) row of throwable_param_table (VERIFIED join).
# note: sound_bank PM_N_<n>.bnk usually names the species; nsi_ex_03 uses PM_N_751.bnk while its Pokémon is 713 (observed, unexplained).
# note: noble_*: slots 7,8,9 (area-local metres) and 11 (LIKELY radians); anchor2_*: slots 17,18,19 (second position, role UNKNOWN).
# note: raw_f21/raw_f24/raw_f25 floats, flag_f16/flag_f20 bools, enc_f3/f13/f14/f15/f32: meaning UNKNOWN.
# note: sex_raw/nature_raw = -1 means not fixed (LIKELY random). iv_raw = slots 26..31 (-1 = not fixed, LIKELY).
# note: field_attack_count: rows of data/boss_field_attacks with the same ns_key; h_count = names with an 'h' variant segment.
